keyMappings:
# Insert your preferred key mappings here.

unmap J
map J nextTab

unmap K
map K previousTab

# only properly work on the us keyboard layout
map ! firstTab count=1
map @ firstTab count=2
map # firstTab count=3
map $ firstTab count=4
map % firstTab count=5
map ^ firstTab count=6
map & firstTab count=7
map * firstTab count=8
map ( firstTab count=9
map ) firstTab count=10
